title: LCARS Capability Profile v2.5
description: Structural schema for a composed Capability Profile. Semantic invariants (enums, value constraints) are checked by Fleet.CapProfile.validate/1 (G24). STRICT: additionalProperties:false at every object level — an unknown/typo'd field (e.g. `containmnet`) is REJECTED, not silently ignored (R0-CAP-001). As the COMPOSED profile (base + modops) is validated here, this also catches junk fields introduced by a modop fragment (R0-CAP-009 backstop).

mounts.description: CATALOGUE mounts projected into the bwrap sandbox (the world provided TO the pod). bwrap_launch binds them at the SAME path, RO/RW, after the /home tmpfs. Inert when containment: none (host = native access). Empty/absent = no extra mount (bare worker).

scope.$comment: allowedTools AND disallowedTools are HARD-REQUIRED by bin/claude_launch.sh (`jq -r '.spec.scope.<field> | join(",")' || exit 1` — an absent field makes `join` hit null, jq fails, the pod NEVER launches). A profile that would crash the launcher is rejected at LOAD time, not at spawn.

sp_template.description: SP template used to materialize a PERMANENT pod (monk, archivist). Distinct from invocation.subagent_template, which implies a one-shot dispatch (G24-11).

skills_plugin_versions.description: Per-plugin version pin (map plugin_name -> semver). Semver regex validated at load.

remote_control.description: Claude Desktop visibility: false makes the launcher omit --remote-control (pod functional but invisible). Default (absent) = true. Set false on ephemeral judges (qualifier/reviewer).

wake_send_keys.description: Send-keys wake fallback authorized for this pod. Default (absent) = true. false = flag-only: the kick loop never types into the pod's terminal (set on the architect - interactive human session); the no-ACK wake.failed escalation remains the terminal net.

deliverable_mode.description: Shape of the role's deliverable, entry condition of Fleet.Workflow.Deliverable.publish/1 (differentiation by catalogue, not by code branch). `payload`: the pod produces a file payload, the SYSTEM writes+commits (verdict roles). `git_native`: the pod commits itself in its workspace, the system verifies (I-CBC gate) then pushes (code roles). Absent: the `payload` default is applied code-side (only relevant to steps with post_extract.git). OPTIONAL-with-default is DELIBERATE, the inverse of its dual `brief_kind` (REQUIRED): a wrong `payload` default is fail-SAFE (`StepRunConsumer.default_deliverable_mode` treats an unresolved role as `payload` = NON-producer, so its output is NEVER pushed as unverified code; only an EXPLICIT `git_native` enters the I-CBC gate), while a wrong `brief_kind` default (`worker`) would be fail-OPEN (a judge would execute attacking content) — hence `brief_kind` required and `deliverable_mode` not. Only the producer (engineer) declares `git_native`; judges/system omit it = correct `payload` default.

brief_kind.description: Shape of the BRIEF the role receives — entry dual of deliverable_mode (differentiation by catalogue, not by magic code name). `worker`: brief = executable instruction (the issue body); the role ACTS. `judge`: the role JUDGES and receives a defused I-CBC GateBrief (context + deliverable + verdict contract, NO executable instruction). REQUIRED (`spec.required`): judge-ness is a SECURITY property, NEVER inferred — a profile without `brief_kind` is REJECTED at load. No silent `worker` default (a judge missing `judge` would fall back to worker=execute = fail-open on attacking content).

allOf.$comment: G24-10 : boot_at_start: true requires lifetime_scope: forever
G24-11 : subagent_template != null requires lifetime_scope: one-shot
G24-12 : host_native: true requires containment: none
